answer: Give each independently audited buyer in a harbor job market two endorsement units. Route these through a trellis of signed referrals and allocate job slots with one max-flow calculation across all applicants. A farm linked through one buyer gets at most two slots, even if 1,000 aliases repeat its success fable. Adding internal referrals cannot enlarge the incoming cut. This shifts the attack toward corrupting audited buyers; weak buyer verification breaks the cap.
